package.name: mobile_manipulator_manipulation
package.description:
Pick-and-place state machine for mobile manipulator.
LEARNING OBJECTIVES: - Understand state machine patterns for robotics - See coordination of perception + arm control - Learn error handling and recovery - Practice safe manipulation sequences
STATE MACHINE: IDLE → DETECTING → PRE_GRASP → GRASPING → POST_GRASP → TRANSPORTING → PRE_PLACE → PLACING → RETRACTING → IDLE
KEY FILES: - pick_place_state_machine.py: Main state machine - grasp_planner.py: Grasp pose computation - manipulation_node.py: ROS2 node wrapper
